others.zh: 维利·勃兰特的东方政策是德国战后历史上最伟大的外交成就之一，它不仅改变了德国在欧洲的地位，也为整个欧洲的和平与和解铺平了道路。
others.en: Willy Brandt's Ostpolitik was one of the greatest diplomatic achievements in German post-war history; it not only changed Germany's position in Europe but also paved the way for peace and reconciliation throughout the continent.

others.zh: 丘吉尔是20世纪最伟大的政治家，他不仅拯救了英国，也拯救了西方文明。
others.en: Churchill was the greatest statesman of the 20th century; he not only saved Britain but also Western civilization.

winston-churchill.othersByEn: John F. Kennedy, President of the United States

others.zh: 索因卡用他的笔和声音，为被压迫者发声，他的作品不仅是文学杰作，更是人类尊严的宣言。
others.en: With his pen and voice, Soyinka speaks for the oppressed; his works are not only literary masterpieces but declarations of human dignity.

others.zh: 莫扎特是音乐的神圣火焰，我们其他人不过是凡人。
others.en: Mozart is the divine flame of music; the rest of us are merely mortals.

others.zh: 《西游记》是中国小说中的一部杰作，它以神话的形式反映了明代社会的现实，同时又超越了时代，成为永恒的经典。
others.en: 'Journey to the West' is a masterpiece in Chinese novels, reflecting the reality of Ming Dynasty society in mythical form while transcending its time to become an eternal classic.

others.zh: 冼星海的音乐是中华民族的精神象征。
others.en: Xian Xinghai's music is a symbol of the spirit of the Chinese nation.

others.zh: 辛弃疾，心系国家，志在恢复，而才气纵横，议论英发，笔势浩荡，有不可一世之概。
others.en: Xin Qiji's heart was always with the nation, his ambition aimed at restoration. His talent was boundless, his arguments brilliant, his writing style magnificent, possessing an unparalleled spirit of his time.

others.zh: 徐悲鸿是中国现代美术教育的奠基人，他的艺术成就和教育贡献对中国美术事业产生了深远影响。
others.en: Xu Beihong is the founder of modern Chinese art education, and his artistic achievements and educational contributions have had a profound impact on China's art cause.

others.zh: 徐霞客足迹所至，几遍天下，其游记之详，考据之精，前无古人，后无来者。
others.en: Wherever Xu Xiake's footsteps reached, he covered almost the entire world. The detail of his travelogue and the precision of his research have no predecessors and no successors.

others.zh: 玄奘法师，是中国佛教史上的一座丰碑，他以毕生精力翻译佛经，传播佛法，其功绩可与鸠摩罗什媲美。
others.en: Master Xuanzang is a monumental figure in the history of Chinese Buddhism. With his lifelong dedication to translating Buddhist scriptures and spreading the Dharma, his achievements can be compared to those of Kumarajiva.

others.zh: 山本五十六是一位卓越的海军战略家，他理解现代海战的本质，但不幸的是，他为错误的事业服务。
others.en: Isoroku Yamamoto was an outstanding naval strategist who understood the nature of modern naval warfare, but unfortunately, he served the wrong cause.

others.zh: 三岛由纪夫是日本战后最伟大的作家，也是最令人困惑的人物。他的作品和死亡都是对战后日本社会的深刻批判。
others.en: Yukio Mishima was the greatest writer of post-war Japan and also the most perplexing figure. His works and death were profound critiques of post-war Japanese society.

yukio-mishima.othersBy: 文学评论家唐纳德·基恩

others.zh: 安德罗波夫是一位被低估的苏联领导人，他的短暂统治本可能改变苏联的命运，但历史没有给他足够的时间。
others.en: Andropov was an underestimated Soviet leader whose brief rule could have changed the fate of the Soviet Union, but history did not give him enough time.

others.zh: 加加林的飞行是人类历史上最伟大的成就之一，它不仅改变了我们对宇宙的看法，也改变了我们对自己的看法。
others.en: Gagarin's flight was one of the greatest achievements in human history, not only changing our view of the universe but also changing our view of ourselves.

others.zh: 张衡之才，盖世无双。
others.en: Zhang Heng's talent is unparalleled in the world.

others.zh: 郑和下西洋，是明朝国力强盛的象征，也是中国古代航海技术的巅峰之作。他的船队规模之大，航行范围之广，在15世纪初的世界无人能及。
others.en: Zheng He's voyages to the Western Oceans were a symbol of Ming Dynasty's power and the pinnacle of ancient Chinese navigation technology. The scale and reach of his fleet were unmatched in the early 15th century.

others.zh: 自朱子后，圣人之道复明，如日之升，如天之开。
others.en: After Master Zhu, the Way of the sages was once again illuminated, like the rising sun, like the opening sky.

others.zh: 同时代及后世文献对其评价分歧明显，既有称颂其统一与恢复之功，也有批评其刑戮过严者；因缺乏可确证的一手直接引语，此处不列具体引文。
others.en: Contemporary and later sources differ markedly, praising his unification and restoration while criticizing excessive severity; as no verifiable first-hand direct quotations are available, no specific quotation is given here.

others.zh: 孔明之才，管、乐之亚匹也。然性骄矜，恃才放旷，此其所以取祸也。
others.en: Zhuge Liang's talent is second only to that of Guan Zhong and Yue Yi. However, his arrogant nature and reliance on his talent led to his downfall.

others.zh: 祖冲之的圆周率计算，是中国古代数学的骄傲，也是世界数学史上的光辉一页。
others.en: Zu Chongzhi's calculation of pi is a source of pride in ancient Chinese mathematics and a brilliant page in the history of world mathematics.
